statements.impact_statement: Rule fires on `res.send(result)` in the DELETE /courses/:id/edit-leases handler (curriculum-controller.ts:531). The `result` argument is the return of EditLeaseService.release/releaseAll (edit-lease-service.ts:82-90): `{ released: boolean }` or `{ released: number }` derived from a Prisma updateMany count — no user-supplied strings ever land in the response body. Express's `res.send` also type-detects the non-string argument and serialises as JSON with Content-Type application/json, so a browser would not render it as HTML even if attacker-controlled content were somehow reflected. Both conditions independently defeat the XSS pattern the rule targets.
